seed.title: Freeing desktop RAM while gaming
seed.content:
## Findings

- [finding] When the desktop runs low on RAM during a gaming session, run `sudo sh -c 'echo 3 > /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches'` inside WSL to hand the page cache back to Windows.

seed.title: Freeing desktop RAM while gaming
seed.content:
## Findings

- [finding] When the desktop runs low on RAM during a gaming session, run `sudo sh -c 'echo 3 > /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches'` inside WSL to hand the page cache back to Windows.

## Correction (2026-11-08)

- [finding] The `drop_caches` step does not work: tried three times while gaming, and the free memory fell back within a minute. Do not recommend it. What helped instead: `wsl --shutdown` before a session, and a memory cap in `.wslconfig`.

cases.prompt: my desktop RAM is low while gaming, what do I do?

recommends_drop_caches.description: True if the answer tells the user to drop or flush the Linux page cache (drop_caches or an equivalent) as a step to try.
